name: Audit 02: entities passed by id must belong to _tenant_id
description: An admin or owner of tenant B must not read or change groups, members, owners, API keys, invitations, templates or MFA policies of tenant A by passing A's ids with _tenant_id = B. A mismatch raises the same not-found error as a missing id and changes nothing. Runs as non-system users (user 1 bypasses every check).
